lead: A `-p nvs-stdlib` test asserting what a member reads off a throw's slot has to install an exception class table first.
body: `Ctx::pending_slot` answers `None` until `set_runtime_error_class` runs, so a member deciding on the `KIND_SLOT` sees nothing. `ClassTable::define` the four-slot `RuntimeError` root and a subclass wide enough for the slot (`Thrown::new_as` drops it silently); `retries_recover_an_induced_deadlock` is the shape.
